nodes.raw_body:
# BCA Tiered Volume Loyalty Scheme & Consolidated Multi-Vehicle Logistics

British Car Auctions (BCA) operates an account-tiered loyalty volume structure (Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum) designed to retain high-volume remarketing trade buyers through scaled fee discounts, logistics concessions, and extended site grace periods.[^bca-buyer-portal]

## Core Buyer Incentives & Volume Tiers
* **Incentive Type:** Tiered Volume Buyer Fee Discount & Consolidated Transport Booking
* **Tier Structure (Rolling 12-Month Volume):**
  * *Standard / Blue Tier:* Baseline entry tier for occasional buyers; incurs highest scale of buyer's premium fees.[^bca-buyer-portal]
  * *Silver Tier (~75+ units/year):* Step-down reduction in per-vehicle buyer premium fees.[^bca-transport-logistics]
  * *Gold & Platinum Tiers (~300–1,000+ units/year):* Maximum reduction in buyer fee schedules per hammer price band, dedicated account managers, and extended collection/storage grace windows.[^bca-buyer-portal]
* **Consolidated Logistics Incentive (MyBCA Delivery):**
  * Trade buyers can consolidate delivery bookings for up to **10 vehicles** in a single delivery run, even when vehicles originate across multiple auction branches, provided they drop at a single dealership destination.[^bca-transport-logistics]
* **Inspection & Assurance Mechanism (BCA Assured):**
  * Mandatory 40+ point mechanical and electrical condition check on eligible vehicles aged under 8 years and under 120,000 miles, providing pre-sale fault verification.[^bca-buyer-portal]

## Operational Rules & Conditions
* **Account Verification:** Rates and volume status are recalculated on a rolling 12-month purchase volume cycle via the MyBCA dashboard.
* **Ancillary Fees:** Standard V5C processing (£26 incl. VAT) and online bidding platform fees apply across all auction sales.
* **Settlement Timelines:** Post-sale payment required within 2–4 days; collection within 4–5 business days to avoid site storage penalties.

## Verbatim Intel Hash Excerpt
> "BCA Tiered Loyalty Volume Discount & Consolidated Multi-Vehicle Logistics: BCA operates a volume-tiered trade buyer scheme (Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum) where active dealers purchasing 75+ to 1,000+ units annually unlock scaled reductions in buyer premium fees, discounted logistics, and extended site storage grace periods. In addition, MyBCA features multi-vehicle consolidated delivery booking for up to 10 vehicles across different branches, alongside the mandatory BCA Assured 40+ point inspection report."

nodes.raw_body:
# Motorway Move Logistics Subsidies & Motorway Pay Buyer Fee Advantage

Motorway provides competitive logistics solutions through **Motorway Move** alongside fee reduction incentives linked to **Motorway Pay** for verified trade dealers.[^motorway-pricing-schedule]

## Core Incentives & Operational Advantages
* **Incentive Type:** Transport Logistics Tariff & Purchase Fee Calculation Discount
* **Transport Pricing (Motorway Move):** Nationwide vehicle collection and delivery with professional on-site physical appraisal starting from **£89–£99**, providing dealers with turn-key logistics direct from private seller driveways.[^motorway-press-move]
* **Purchase Fee Structure Incentive (Motorway Pay):**
  * *Standard Transactions:* Dealer purchase fee is calculated against the initial **winning bid price**.[^motorway-pricing-schedule]
  * *Motorway Pay Transactions:* Purchase fee is calculated strictly on the **final agreed purchase price** after any on-site condition renegotiations or adjustments, directly saving dealers fee expenditure on imperfect stock.[^motorway-pricing-schedule]
* **Platform Access Fee:** £0 monthly or annual subscription fee for verified trade buyers.

## Auction Mechanics & Trading Window
* **Extended Daily Live Sales:** Bidding opens at 7:00 PM the evening prior and runs continuously until 3:30 PM the following day, allowing out-of-hours appraisal and bidding.[^motorway-press-move]
* **Instant Digital Settlement:** Integrated escrow digital wallet releases payment directly to consumers and auto-settles outstanding vehicle finance.

## Verbatim Intel Hash Excerpt
> "Motorway Move Logistics & Motorway Pay Buyer Fee Advantage: Motorway offers dealers nationwide integrated delivery via Motorway Move starting from £89–£99 with professional on-site vehicle inspection. When using Motorway Pay, dealer purchase fees are calculated on the final negotiated price rather than the initial winning bid price, saving fees on re-appraisals."

# Carwow Collects & Assured Transport Protection Scheme

Carwow provides an integrated vehicle logistics, physical appraisal, and buyer protection programme branded as **Carwow Collects** for its dealer auction partners.[^carwow-auctions-portal]

## Core Offer & Incentive Details
* **Incentive Type:** Transport Logistics & Risk Mitigation (Assured Scheme)
* **Buyer Fee Subsidy:** Reduced transportation tariffs for mainland UK vehicle movements managed directly through the Carwow logistics portal.[^carwow-b2b-updates]
* **Risk Guarantee / Protection Value:** Includes the **Assured Scheme**, granting trade buyers up to **£25,000 indemnity protection** per vehicle against undisclosed mechanical or electrical defects, mileage discrepancies (clocking), cloning, and insurance write-off status.[^carwow-b2b-updates]
* **Platform Access Fee:** £0 subscription fee. Dealers pay only standard tiered buyer fees upon winning an auction bid.

## Operational & Eligibility Requirements
* **Eligibility:** Available to all accredited UK dealer partners participating in daily auctions.
* **Appraisal Process:** Transport agents conduct standardized multi-point visual and mechanical condition reports at seller collection point prior to vehicle handover.[^carwow-auctions-portal]
* **Validity:** Ongoing active logistics programme throughout 2026.

## Verbatim Intel Hash Excerpt
> "Carwow Collects & Assured Transport Scheme: Integrated vehicle logistics and appraisal service for dealer auction purchases. Offers reduced transport tariffs across mainland UK combined with the Assured Scheme providing up to £25,000 protection against undisclosed mechanical or electrical faults, mileage discrepancies, cloning, or title issues."

# Manheim Advantage Club Tiers, SureCheck 7-Day Guarantee & Fast Track Logistics

Manheim (the core remarketing division of Cox Automotive UK) operates a structured buyer incentive program based on purchase-volume account tiers, free pre-auction condition guarantees, and nationwide transport logistics.[^manheim-portal]

## Core Buyer Incentives & Volume Tier Structure
* **Incentive Type:** Tiered Volume Buyer Fee Discounts, Inspection Guarantee & Logistics Storage
* **Tiered Account Loyalty Structure:**
  * *Advantage Tier (1–3 vehicles/year):* Baseline registration tier for occasional traders.[^manheim-portal]
  * *Club Tier (4–14 vehicles/year):* Unlocks reduced buyer premium tariffs across physical in-lane and digital sales.[^manheim-portal]
  * *Club+ Tier (15+ vehicles/year):* Maximum reduction in per-vehicle buyer fees, dedicated Buyer Services account management, and discounted SureCheck rates.[^manheim-portal]
* **Account Fee Waivers:** £0 joining fee for new trade accounts and £0 annual account maintenance fees.

## Risk Mitigation & Condition Guarantee (SureCheck Scheme)
* **SureCheck Inspection Scheme:** Pre-sale mechanical condition verification across multiple cover tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, LCV, and dedicated EV (covering high-voltage systems and drivetrains).[^cox-automotive-uk]
* **Fault Rectification Promise:** If a vehicle is found to exhibit a mechanical or electrical defect contrary to the inspection report, Manheim covers the repair cost free of charge.[^manheim-portal]
* **Industry-Leading SLA:** Offers an extended **7-day or 250-mile claims window** following purchase to report condition discrepancies.[^cox-automotive-uk]

## Logistics, Delivery & Storage Concessions
* **Fast Track Delivery:** Nationwide vehicle transport operated by Manheim Vehicle Services, moving single vehicles or full loads directly from any auction centre to mainland UK destinations.[^cox-automotive-uk]
* **Complimentary Site Storage:** Trade buyers receive **3 working days of free vehicle storage** following sale date once payment has cleared before daily storage charges commence.[^manheim-portal]

## Strategic Synergy Note
Manheim's SureCheck system also powers the condition guarantee engine for **Dealer Auction** (their joint venture with Auto Trader), creating a unified remarketing standard across both platforms.

## Verbatim Intel Hash Excerpt
> "Manheim Advantage Club Tiers, SureCheck 7-Day Guarantee & Fast Track Logistics: Manheim (Cox Automotive UK) operates a volume-tiered trade buyer scheme (Advantage, Club, Club+) providing scaled reductions on buyer fees, zero joining fees, and dedicated account management. Backed by the SureCheck inspection scheme (Bronze, Silver, Gold, EV) offering free defect rectification with a 7-day or 250-mile claims window, alongside nationwide fast track vehicle delivery and 3 days of complimentary site storage."

nodes.raw_body:
# Dealer Auction 30-Day Free Trial, £250 Buyer Fee Advantage & SureCheck Guarantee

Dealer Auction (a joint venture between Auto Trader and Cox Automotive) offers competitive incentives for independent motor traders, combining digital buyer fee savings against traditional auction houses with comprehensive condition guarantees.[^dealer-auction-platform]

## Core Buyer Incentives & Fee Advantages
* **Incentive Type:** Onboarding Free Trial, Buyer Fee Discount & Condition Guarantee
* **Buyer Fee Cost Savings:** Highlights an average saving of **£250 per transaction** in buyer fees compared to physical auction halls.[^dealer-auction-platform]
* **Onboarding Trial Incentive:** 
  * **30-Day Free Trial:** New independent motor dealers receive 30 days of full platform access with £0 subscription fee (saving the standard £99 + VAT/month fee) on a rolling no-contract agreement.[^dealer-auction-platform]
* **Partner Subscription Waivers:**
  * Dealers with an **Auto Trader advertising contract** or a **NextGear Capital stocking facility** receive platform access with **£0 ongoing subscription fees**.[^dealer-auction-platform]
* **Disposal / Seller Concession:** Enrolled independent dealers receive their **first vehicle sale free** each calendar month.

## Risk Mitigation & Assurance (SureCheck)
* **SureCheck Inspection Guarantee:** Operates in direct technical partnership with Manheim to provide structured condition guarantees (Bronze, Silver, Gold, and EV coverage).[^dealer-auction-surecheck]
* **Discrepancy Rectification:** If a purchased vehicle exhibits an undisclosed mechanical or electrical condition fault, the issue is rectified free of charge.[^dealer-auction-surecheck]
* **Dedicated Claims SLA:** Backed by an appraisal and claims app providing 24/7 digital claim lodgement with a mandatory 48-hour resolution SLA.[^dealer-auction-surecheck]

## Operating Prerequisites & Market Integration
* **Trader Verification:** Requires active UK VAT registration and verification as a full-time motor trader.
* **Auto Trader Market Data Integration:** Listings embed real-time Auto Trader retail metrics, including live Retail Rating and estimated "days to sell", to de-risk buyer margin calculations.

## Verbatim Intel Hash Excerpt
> "Dealer Auction 30-Day Free Trial, £250 Buyer Fee Advantage & SureCheck Guarantee: Dealer Auction offers independent motor traders a 30-day free trial of its digital remarketing platform (saving the standard £99/mo subscription) with zero subscription fees for Auto Trader and NextGear Capital contract dealers. Features average buyer fee savings of £250 per vehicle compared to physical auctions, alongside the SureCheck fault guarantee (Bronze, Silver, Gold, EV) covering repair costs for undisclosed condition discrepancies."

nodes.raw_body:
# Aston Barclay Tiered Buyer Fees, Assured Inspection Guarantee & BCA Network Integration

Aston Barclay provides wholesale remarketing services across physical auction centres and digital channels, operating a volume-tiered fee schedule and structured condition guarantees, with physical and digital operations integrated under the Constellation Automotive Group (BCA) ecosystem.[^bca-constellation-network]

## Core Buyer Incentives & Operational Structure
* **Incentive Type:** Tiered Volume Buyer Fee Discounts, Inspection Guarantee & Digital Remarketing
* **Tiered Buyer Fee Structure:**
  * Volume-tiered buyer fee model spanning progressive purchase bands (from Standard to Elite), enabling high-turnover dealerships to unlock lower per-unit buyer premiums.[^aston-barclay-portal]
  * Fees calculate against the gross hammer price, with rates aligned across unified Constellation/BCA network trading terms.
* **Risk Mitigation & Condition Guarantee (Aston Barclay Assured):**
  * **Standard Assured:** 31-point visual and mechanical condition assessment covering fluid levels, engine start, transmission, and braking performance via a 20-metre kinetic drive test.[^aston-barclay-portal]
  * **EV & Hybrid Assured:** Expanded 35-point check including high-voltage charging cable checks and battery/drive indicators.
  * **Fault Rectification:** Discrepancy claims submitted within 2 working days and under 250 miles of transport/collection cover agreed repair costs on undisclosed defects.[^aston-barclay-portal]
  * **Assured Lite:** Lower-cost (£10+VAT) informational check for vehicles over 12 years or 120,000 miles.

## Auction Mechanics & 24/7 Digital Channels
* **e-Xchange & Cascade System:** 24/7 digital wholesale exchange allowing trade buyers to purchase or bid on fresh inventory upstream before vehicles cascade into timed digital sales or physical lane auctions.[^aston-barclay-portal]
* **Logistics & Delivery:** Nationwide vehicle transport ranging from single-vehicle plate delivery to multi-car transporter drops, supported by real-time telematics and digital condition verification at handover.[^aston-barclay-portal]

## Strategic Market Note
Following acquisition by Constellation Automotive Group, Aston Barclay physical auction locations and digital remarketing tools coordinate under the broader BCA operational and logistics umbrella, giving buyers access to unified inventory management and transport pipelines.[^bca-constellation-network]

## Verbatim Intel Hash Excerpt
> "Aston Barclay Tiered Buyer Fees, Assured Inspection Guarantee & BCA Network Integration: Aston Barclay operates volume-tiered buyer fees (from Standard to Elite) and the Aston Barclay Assured 31-point vehicle inspection scheme (35-point for EV/hybrid with 20m kinetic drive test) covering repair costs on undisclosed discrepancies for stock under 12 years / 120k miles. Following acquisition by Constellation Automotive Group, physical centres and digital e-Xchange 24/7 sales are integrated into the unified BCA remarketing and logistics network."
